title: Catalog product entry
description: Structure only: required and forbidden members, types, enumerations, string patterns, and length and count limits. A document this schema accepts can still be refused by the engine, because the engine's relational and time-based rules cannot be expressed here; the Python validator in public_pilot is authoritative. Not expressed here: that the file is named <product_id>.json; that the theme and author resolve and list this product; that public_history_path is history/<product_id>. Authoritative: public_pilot.catalog, run by `public-pilot catalog check`.
$comment: Patterns end in $(?!\n) so that regular-expression engines whose $ also matches before a final newline still require a whole-string match. JSON Schema counts 1.0 as an integer; the engine requires integer literals.
